title: Suite Magnolia II Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Suite Magnolia II is the rear guest home perfect for young families that easily sleeps five. Full Kitchen, great porches, and a prime heart of Seaside location, walk to over 40 shops and restaurants steps from home!
description_expanded: Description640 FOREST STREET1 Queen, 1 Full with Twin Trundle, Sleeps 5Suite Magnolia II – Home in the Heart of Seaside with Private Beach AccessSuite Magnolia II is a two-bedroom vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, thoughtfully designed for families and small groups seeking a relaxed and walkable 30A beach getaway. Located just a five-minute walk to Seaside’s private beach access and only four minutes to the West End Family Pool, this home places you in the center of everything. From the iconic Airstream food trucks to more than 40 restaurants, cafés, and boutiques, the best of Seaside is just steps from your front door.Functional Layout Designed for FamiliesThis lockoff configuration offers a practical and comfortable layout, with all sleeping accommodations located on the first floor and the main gathering space upstairs. By separating the bedrooms from the living areas, guests can enjoy quiet rest below while others relax or socialize on the second level. The design is especially well-suited for families with children or groups who appreciate a balance of shared space and privacy.Private First-Floor Bedrooms with En Suite BathroomsThe first floor is dedicated to sleeping accommodations, offering privacy and convenience for every guest. The first guest bedroom features a queen bed and a private ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower, creating a comfortable retreat for couples or parents. The second guest bedroom includes a full bed with a twin trundle, comfortably sleeping up to three guests. This room also offers a private ensuite bathroom with a shower/tub combination, making it a practical option for families traveling with children. With two bedrooms and two private bathrooms on the first floor, the layout is ideal for families or mixed-age groups seeking both comfort and functionality.Open-Concept Living on the Second FloorUpstairs, the second floor features a bright, open-concept layout that brings together the kitchen, living room, and dining area. Elevated ceilings and natural light create an inviting atmosphere for gathering and relaxing.The living room offers comfortable seating and a mounted flat-screen television, providing the perfect space to unwind after a day on the beach. The adjacent dining area allows everyone to gather for meals, board games, or morning coffee before exploring Seaside and Scenic Highway 30A.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Half BathThe kitchen is fully equipped with a full-size refrigerator, electric cooktop, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, cookware, and ample cabinetry. Whether you’re preparing a quick breakfast or enjoying a family dinner at home, everything you need is provided.A convenient half bathroom is located on the second floor off the main living area, adding ease and functionality to the shared space.A Walkable Seaside, Florida Vacation RentalSuite Magnolia II combines flexible sleeping arrangements, private bathrooms for each bedroom, and one of the most desirable locations in Seaside, Florida. With private beach access, proximity to the West End Family Pool, and immediate access to dining and shopping, this 30A vacation rental is an ideal home base for your next Gulf Coast getaway.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Fall; 5-night minimum Summer; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES352 yards or a 5 minute walk to private Seaside beach access at West Ruskin PavilionFour minute walk to West Side Family Pool Two queen bedrooms with ensuite bathsWalkable to shops, dining, and Seaside town centerScreened porch with outdoor dining and rocking chairsOutdoor charcoal grillAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball courts (court fees apply) and a fitness center.Welcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets allowed
